rows.note: Use this all-purpose spoken choice for something completed or happening on schedule and not late.

example.english: We started the meeting at eight, which was timely.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zeon2 si4 baat3 dim2 hoi1 wui2

rows.note: Use this when an action or event happens in time to be useful or at the needed moment, rather than merely according to a schedule.

example.english: I arrived in time to call an ambulance for him; my arrival was timely.
example.traditional: 我及時趕到，幫佢叫咗白車。
example.jyutping: ngo5 kap6 si4 gon2 dou3 bong1 keoi5 giu3 zo2 baak6 ce1

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when something happens at exactly the right moment, especially when describing its timing in context.

example.english: Your return was timely—you got back just as dinner was being served.
example.traditional: 你返到嚟嗰陣，啱啱好開飯。
example.jyutping: nei5 faan1 dou3 lei4 go2 zan6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 hoi1 faan6
